prose: Base Browser, hosted on Codeberg, is a hard fork of Firefox advertised as shipping 'with no AI slop' - a reaction release for users who want a mainstream browser without built-in AI features. The project page could not be retrieved (the fetch returned an error), so versioning and divergence details are unavailable; this summary is based on the headline.
highlights: Base Browser: Firefox hard fork with no AI features
A reaction release against built-in browser AI
